against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Aug 5 high is not done: it is one straight leg and it is too quick for the advance before it. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Oct 6, 2023–Aug 5 advance (−34% to −51%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Feb 4 to Aug 5 (+123%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−17% to −28%), in three waves, with the 50-day average and the Dec 15, 2025 high in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−43%); a close over the wave-1 high (+27%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: A bull flag
material.text: It ran +40% in 14 sessions, then drifted for 8 sessions on lighter volume, giving back 42% of the run: a pause that often precedes the next leg.
material.learn: A sharp move (the pole), then a shallow drift on light volume (the flag); the next leg often matches much of the pole.
